notes.title: 0.2.15 minor tweaks
notes.content: Played through the game after last upload and decided to tweak a couple of things.

notes.title: Update 0.2.14 - Cinematic Intro and Level 3 - The Catacombs Added!
notes.content: This is a big, exciting update! You can now explore the catacombs, and face the evils, therein! Also, check   out that new cinematic trailer!

notes.title: 0.2.10 fixed some minor bugs
notes.content: I won't bore ye with the details.

notes.title: 0.2.10 - 1st Boss Fight Improvements
notes.content: I've added some juiciness to the first boss fight and made a few other minor tweaks.

notes.title: 0.2.9 Settings adjustment
notes.content: Had a few settings off in game. Fixed!

notes.title: 0.2.8 More bug fixes, Improved boss fight
notes.content: Fixed a lot of things in this patch. Bugs is hatin life.

notes.title: 0.2.7 More bug fixes
notes.content: The fight with the Queen was broken and she wasn't doing any damage. Fixed! Fixed a few other things as well.

notes.title: 0.2.6.5 More bugs facing the boot! 2nd level playable.
notes.content: More bugs have been squashed! The 2nd level should be mostly playable. Still need to tweak the boss fight a good bit.

notes.title: 0.2.6 Linux now live!
notes.content: As with any updates, please let me know if you experience any bugs or other problems. Thank you!

notes.title: Update 0.2.6
notes.content: This update fixed a few minor bugs. Next I will get Deck of Darkness live on Linux/SteamOS. Once again, please forgive any bugs!

notes.title: Early Access official release.
notes.content:
Hello all! This updates the game to the early access version. My release this morning was the same as the demo since it had already been approved for release. Thanks for checking out my game! If you'd like to join my sleepy little discord, come on by: [url=https://discord.com/invite/XqMe7Vdrhy]https://discord.com/invite/XqMe7Vdrhy[/url]
Please forgive any *ahem* bugs, but this baby is fresh out of the demonic womb! I will be trying to publish at least small updates a few times a week as we go.

We got hundreds of wishlists during Next Fest. Thank you for that! Thanks to anyone who supports indie game development!

Stay tuned!

Morgan
